title: eustachys pyramidale
intro: Eustachys pyramidale, commonly known as the Red Plume Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Eustachys pyramidale include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, ease pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
